rows.details: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya, Raipur (C.G.) – Department of Agri-Business and Rural Management, College of Agriculture
Honorarium Rs. 1200/- to Rs. 1800/- per working day (maximum Rs. 26000/- to Rs. 40000/- per month), by qualification
Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks, plus NET (conditions below)
Maximum 40 years (up to 45 years with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and women)

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Guest Teacher in the subject Agri-Business Management (कृषि व्यवसाय प्रबंधन), 01 vacancy. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% Marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 in 10.00 scales) with good academic record. For candidates having a Master degree, NET (National Eligibility Test) shall remain compulsory, along with one publication in a NAAS (National Academy of Agricultural Science, New Delhi) rated refereed journal, for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. The essentiality of NET can be waived for candidates holding a Ph.D. degree, provided the Ph.D. has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulations 2009 and the candidate has at least two full length publications in journals having a NAAS rating not less than 4 on the last date of submission of application. Candidates with a Ph.D. degree without course work will not qualify for NET exemption. For the full eligibility wording, candidates should check the official notification. The maximum age limit for Guest Teachers is 40 years. Candidates of the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Backward Classes and women get 5 years' relaxation as per Chhattisgarh Government rules, but the maximum age including such relaxation will not exceed 45 years. If the Chhattisgarh Government increases or amends the maximum age limit, those provisions will apply to Guest Teachers. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. A Guest Teacher will not be entitled to any other allowance or facility apart from this honorarium. The tenure of the selected Guest Teacher is for the courses run in the academic session 2026-27.

rows.relaxation: 5 years (maximum age with relaxation not more than 45 years)

rows.guest_teacher_who_has_passed: Only post-graduation in the related subject

content_sections.heading: IGKV Agri-Business Management Job Description
content_sections.text: Teaching in the MBA (ABM) and Ph.D. (ABM) courses run by the Department of Agri-Business and Rural Management, College of Agriculture, Raipur. Working, as directed from time to time, in the college's academic, examination, laboratory and other activities.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form asks for these documents: Self-attested coloured passport photo, affixed on the form. Copies of certificate, degree and marks sheet / transcript for each examination passed (High School, HSC/Intermediate/Pre University, Bachelors, Masters, Doctoral and any other examination). Copy of the certificate of NET conducted by ICAR/UGC, if qualified. Copies of certificates for academic excellence: gold, silver or bronze medal at UG/PG/Ph.D., and JRF/SRF of ICAR/CSIR/GATE etc. Complete list of research/extension publications in bibliographical form, with reprints as proof. Certificate from the competent authority, if the candidate is disabled. Copies of certificates for extra-curricular activities (NCC/NSS/University band/Games and Sports/Cultural at Inter University/National Level).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be interviewed on 25 November 2026 at the College of Agriculture (Department of Agri-Business and Rural Management), Raipur; the interview starts at 11:30 AM. Candidates must bring the originals and self-attested photocopies of all documents to the interview. The application form also states that a JRF/SRF of ICAR/CSIR/GATE etc., or a fellowship through any university examination or competition with financial support availed, will be considered at 2 marks for each. The application form also records medals, publications, teaching or research experience and extra-curricular achievements.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IGKV Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for Guest Teacher in Agri-Business Management at the College of Agriculture, Raipur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IGKV Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: The application with all documents must be sent to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IGKV Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: A Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks (or grade 6.50 in 10.00 scales), with NET and one NAAS rated refereed journal publication. NET can be waived for Ph.D. holders with course work as per UGC Regulations 2009 and two full length publications in journals with NAAS rating not less than 4.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IGKV Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years. SC, ST, OBC and women get 5 years' relaxation as per Chhattisgarh Government rules, but the maximum age with relaxation cannot exceed 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the honorarium for the IGKV Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: Rs. 1800/- per working day (maximum Rs. 40000/- per month) for Ph.D. and NET or Ph.D. holders, Rs. 1500/- (maximum Rs. 36000/-) for post-graduates with NET, and Rs. 1200/- (maximum Rs. 26000/-) for post-graduates only.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IGKV Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form attached to the advertisement and email it with all documents to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the IGKV Guest Teacher interview?
faq.answer: The interview will start at 11:30 AM on 25 November 2026 at the College of Agriculture (Department of Agri-Business and Rural Management), Raipur. Bring originals and self-attested copies of all documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IGKV Guest Teacher post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the tenure of the selected Guest Teacher is for the courses run in the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q9. Will the IGKV Guest Teacher get any allowances besides the honorarium?
faq.answer: No, a Guest Teacher will not be entitled to any other allowance or facility apart from the honorarium, and no travelling allowance is paid for attending the interview.
